title: Ring
summary: A ring supports addition, multiplication, and additive inverses under compatible laws.

content.plain: A ring supports addition, multiplication, and additive inverses under compatible laws.
content.exact: A ring (R,+,·) has an abelian group under +, associative multiplication, and left/right distributivity; identity and commutativity conventions must be stated.
content.example: Integers form a commutative ring with identity.
content.caveat: Authors differ on whether a ring must have 1.
